paragraphs.text: Because they are members of the same body, he sets them before our eyes, who are most willing and by their prompt obedience teach us to do our duty.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: In that God's glory shines in these insensible creatures, this their beauty is as a continual praising of God.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Not that there are various heavens, but because of the spheres and of the situation of the fixed stars and planets, he comprehends by this word the whole heavens.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: That is, the rain which is in the middle region of the air, which he here comprehends under the name of the heavens.
paragraphs.label: d
paragraphs.anchor: waters that be above the heavens

paragraphs.text: Meaning the great and monstrous fishes, as whales and such like.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: Which come not by chance or fortune, but by God's appointed ordinance.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: For the greater gifts that any has received and the more high that one is preferred, the more bound is he to praise God for the same: but neither high nor low condition or degree can be exempted from this duty.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: That is, the dignity, power and glory of his Church.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: By reason of his covenant made with Abraham.
paragraphs.label: i
